0022600204.text: The Cavaliers (5-4, 6th in the East) enter as the second-place team in the Central, 1.5 games back, on a one-game win streak, though they are just 1-3 on the road. The Hornets (3-7, 10th in the East) have lost six straight and sit 3 games back in the Southeast. Cleveland is without Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain), and Sam Merrill (elbow), while Charlotte is missing Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring), and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), with Brandon Miller (groin) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 118-113 win in Charlotte on February 20, 2026.
